title: Require CodeQL SARIF uploads
summary: Require the advanced CodeQL workflow to upload SARIF findings to GitHub Code Scanning instead of retaining artifact-only results.
reason: The repository is now public and Code Scanning is available, but the prior opt-in upload fallback could let checks pass without publishing findings. The strict CI baseline must preserve actual scanning evidence.
behavior_before: CodeQL wrote SARIF artifacts but defaulted the upload input to never unless a repository variable opted in.
behavior_after: CodeQL always uploads SARIF to Code Scanning, retains the artifact evidence, and the audit spine rejects the former opt-out fallback.
manual_validation: GitHub audit-spine guard and YAML parsing passed with CodeQL upload set to always.
The deep-audit suite passed with the strict CodeQL upload contract.
The phase1 generated audit suite passed after refreshing affected summaries.
rollback_plan: Restore the prior CodeQL artifact-only upload fallback only if repository Code Scanning becomes unavailable and an explicit security decision approves that reduced assurance; rerun the audit spine and workflow validation.
